from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485477/attempts/121aa726ce1d47daa341412ab2c8dccb/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program='''def transform(grid):\n    background = max(set(value for row in grid for value in row), key=lambda value: sum(row.count(value) for row in grid))\n    return [[background] * len(grid[0])] + [row[:] for row in grid[:-1]]\n'''
file=progdir/'task-93bf4dfc.py'
file.write_text(program)
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_program', file)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
demo_in=[[8]*21 for _ in range(8)]

for r,cs in demo_pts.items():

demo_out=[[8]*21 for _ in range(8)]
outpts={1:[12],2:[8,10,11],3:[9,10,11,12],4:[8,12,13,14,15],5:[6,7,10,11,13,14],6:[10,11,12],7:[12,13,15]}
